scope: Exact-version install-script review and Node24 CI action upgrade

review.esbuild: Selects the exact platform binary, links it locally and checks its reported version; missing optional binary fallback fetches the same version and verifies an embedded SHA256 binary digest. An explicit operator ESBUILD_BINARY_PATH can override selection.
review.unrs-resolver: Runs locked napi-postinstall0.3.4 to locate the exact1.11.1 platform binding and check package versions. Normal npm install includes the locked optional binding. Missing-binding fallback can invoke npm or download from configured registry; that direct fallback does not itself check an SRI digest. No fallback was exercised in this review.
review.currentPlatform: Both Linux x64 optional binary packages are installed; install:ci includes optional dependencies.
review.approvalBoundary: Only esbuild0.28.1 and unrs-resolver1.11.1 are approved. No wildcard, name-only approval, approve-all or policy disabling is added.

validation.workflow: Parsed YAML; exact structure unchanged except two uses values
validation.installScripts: Lockfile contains exactly the two reviewed hasInstallScript entries; installed review bytes match independently downloaded archive integrities.
validation.npmPolicyCommand: Local npm11.9.0 does not implement npm install-scripts ls. Official current npm documentation confirms the exact-version allowScripts format; warning absence must be checked by the newer Vercel installer.
